UFURBAN FRACTUREAN ORIGINAL ARCADE BRAWLER
HOSPITAL WITNESS MISSION 315

TWO OPENING ROUTES / NORMAL DIFFICULTY

Her city. Their last mistake.

Choose Downtown’s streets or Uptown’s promenade beneath one changing sky.
Fight through Uptown’s outdoor strip mall, then choose the woods or Riverfront Walk from Lakeside Park.

CHOOSE YOUR OPENING

SIX ESTABLISHED HEROES / NIGHTSHADE INTEGRATION

Choose your fighter.

Reina selected · 105 HP

Standing combos continue only if the opening attack connects with an enemy. Choose before starting either stage. Controller: left / right to choose, Options / × to start. Your fighter carries through checkpoints.

PLAY WITH CONTROLLER ↗Connect controller and press a face button.

This embedded window blocks controller access. Use Play with Controller to open the game in its own tab.

REINA / THE FIRST NIGHT

DOWNTOWN
FIRST CONTACT

A street full of syndicate muscle. A lead worth fighting for.
Clear downtown, then take the fight to Union National Bank and Leroy’s vault.

J COMBOK JUMP→ GRABL SPECIAL
PS5: ↑ / ↓ choose scene · × start · ← / → choose fighter

Keyboard: WASD / J / K · PS5: Options start, □ attack, × jump, L1 block · R1 counter · Controller check below

TAKE A BREATH

PAUSED

Stage artwork couldn’t load.
READY WHEN YOU ARE.
OPEN GAME IN OWN TAB ↗

Press a face button to check live input.

CONTROLLER READY · CONNECT AND PRESS A BUTTON

DualSense / PS5 · Left stick or D-pad: move · □: tap attack / hold-release power strike · ×: jump · △: special · ○: dodge · L1: block · R1: neutral counter · R3: pick up / throw · L2: grab / release · double-tap + hold: run · R2: Nightshade Unique Action (legacy run on other heroes) · forward, forward + □: character blitz · Options: start / pause · L3 + Options: developer menu

Connect by USB or Bluetooth, open Play with Controller above, then press Options. With DSX, select its virtual Xbox controller under Device. If the controller does not respond, press RESET CONTROLLER, then press Options or ×. If buttons respond incorrectly, choose Set Up Buttons once; your mapping is saved in this browser. Direction + □ throws; forward + △ uses your forward special. × confirms menus and retries the current checkpoint. Xbox-style controllers use X / A / Y / B, LB block / RB counter / LT grab / RT run and Start.

REINA / KNOW YOUR MOVES

Get close. Take control.

Keyboard + controller + touch
01

Strike & move

WASD / arrows move · Shift run.
Tap J for a three-kick combo: roundhouse, tornado roundhouse, spinning hook kick. Each kick advances; the final kick knocks down.
Hold Attack 2s, then release: Tornado Kick · 40-damage jumping roundhouse. A READY cue confirms full charge; hold longer if needed, then release.
Walk while charging (running disabled) · jump / evade cancels · vulnerable startup · no cooldown.
Running + J or forward, forward + J: circular axe-kick blitz.
Multi-hit axe kick knocks enemies down.
3s recovery after landing.
Double-tap and hold a horizontal direction to run until release.
Neutral jump + J: downward heel kick.
Moving jump + J: forward kick · 11 damage.
Air + down + J: knee drop · 10 damage; G grab follow-up.
Down + Attack does not target grounded enemies. Dedicated ground submissions are Niko-only.

02

Grab & switch sides

Walk into an enemy to grab.
G release / manual grab.
J two knees, stepping face elbow, then a crouching opposite-hand palm to the midsection · forward + J outer reap.
Front hold + back + J hip throw.
Hold direction + Attack through a knee to throw next.
K maneuver around the enemy while holding.
Rear hold + back + J: release German suplex.
Rear hold + forward + J: high hook kick · 40 damage and knockdown.

03

Make an opening

B / L1 holds block. C / R1 attempts the one neutral counter; directions do not choose variants. Every actionable attempt costs15% defense, including a miss. A successful regular-enemy capture adds25% (40% total); a heavy/strong/boss capture adds65% (80% total). Heavy targets must be strictly below40% remaining HP.
Normal timing windows: Reina/Niko12 frames; Nova/Forest/Orion8; Broxton6. Counter cannot start while blocking, in a cutscene, or during mandatory recovery.
A successful punch or kick is visibly stopped. Press Attack during the hold to execute; Reina/Niko may instead press Special. No follow-up input releases the enemy without automatic counter damage. Timed weapon counters execute automatically.
Reina: punch → back shoulder throw. Kick → rear grab, with50% extra damage on the following rear-grab attack; front switching is disabled. Short weapon → disarm and steal. Long weapon → dodge behind. E / R3 picks up or throws a foreign weapon; each has five uses.
Defense recharges at9/sec after the normal1.5s delay. Q cartwheel through a thug · 25% defense · 2s cooldown.
L spinning sword clear-out · 12 HP; invincible and ignores enemy defenses. Front grab + Special: push, two sword slices · 43 damage · 18 HP.
Forward + L downward dash slash · 35 damage · 18 HP.
Airborne specials are disabled.

After the catch: Special → Rising Dragon Blade. Deflect, draw the short sword and leap into the established upward slash:56 base damage,64-frame sequence. Confirmed activation costs8% maximum HP (cannot kill by activation); shared40%/80% defense totals apply. Recovery remains mandatory. Projectiles and weapon captures cannot select this Special.

✦ Pizza restores 30% of maximum HP.✦ Carmen: avoid the taser up close.✦ Grabbed? Tap J / K to escape.✦ Bump or strike furniture to knock it over.

BROXTON / THE TURNCOAT

Heavy hands. A clean break.

A former syndicate enforcer fighting for the heroes. Slower than Reina, stronger at close range, and vulnerable during heavy windups. Strong enemies and bosses resist ordinary grabs above40% HP. A committed grab attack then has a25% chance of success; failure triggers a synchronized retaliation. Letting the contested hold expire causes no damage. Regular enemies have no random initial resistance. After a throw, reposition and wait for brief grab-only protection after their get-up. Active Iron Will lets Broxton bypass combat grab restrictions.

Strike & close distance

The opening punch must connect to continue. Attack: two jabs, a straight punch and a short rushing uppercut; the final hit staggers without automatically knocking down. Forward, forward + Attack: a running diving lariat with an arm sweep, palm landing, multiple targets, knockdown and punishable get-up recovery. During the committed sweep he can withstand one ordinary frontal hit without flinching while still taking damage; startup, rear attacks and recovery remain vulnerable. Hold Attack 3s then release: Iron Will. Ten seconds of 50% ordinary attack damage and resistance to stagger, knockdown and grabs;75s cooldown starts when it ends. Hazards and explicitly scripted mechanics retain their rules. Jump + Attack: neutral heel kick or moving downward punch with brief stun. Air + down + Attack: diagonal elbow drop (16 damage).

Take control

Touch to grab. Attack: two headbutts, then a knockback uppercut. Each hit requires a separate press; choose a throw between hits. Front hold + back + Attack: full 360-degree spin with a backward throw. Front hold + forward + Attack: football tackle, mounted four-punch finish and standing recovery (26 damage, no special cost). Block or Dodge during the punches to dismount defensively. Rear hold + back + Attack: overhead backbreaker, then a short backward toss. Rear hold + forward + Attack: overhead forward throw into nearby enemies. Hold Jump/Grab Transition alone to raise a Human Shield (12-frame setup;2.5s maximum). Hold it with a direction to reposition up to one body-width without switching grab orientation. Release the shield button early for a zero-damage shove and short recovery. Front Grab + Special: one-handed chokeslam (23 HP),72 damage and extended knockdown. Committed throws are protected; their startup and recovery remain vulnerable.

Power has a price

Special: spinning punch clear-out (17 HP). Forward + Special: dash grab into jumping slam (23 HP), 47 damage, shorter reach and one-hit approach armor, with knockback around the impact and invincibility throughout. Whiffs still cost health; the forward special follows strong-target grab resistance unless Iron Will is active. Airborne specials are disabled. L1 blocks. Counters: punch → bodyweight lift/slam; kick → running cross; knife → arm takedown and jumping stomp; long weapon → catch and steal. Shared neutral-counter rules apply. Boxing Shuffle costs15% defense; a timed forward Slip & Pivot costs20% and opens a short manual rear-grab opportunity. Two-second cooldown. Broxton gets up without rolling; protected wake-up cannot attack.

THE CAST

Six heroes and a new operative.

VIEW ANIMATED SPRITES →
PLAYABLE / 125 HP / POWER

Broxton

A former syndicate enforcer. Strong punches, deliberate footwork, devastating grabs.

ROBBER / 65 HP

Jesse

Six aimed shots. Knives up close. Punish the reload.

BANK SECURITY / 175 HP

Otis

Baton, belly ram and body splash. Attack when he is winded.

VAULT BOSS / 315 HP

Leroy

Evasive gunfire, brass knuckles, grenades below half health, and limited backup waves.

KNIFE THUG / STAB + STEP SLASH

Kevin

Stab, step-in slash and fast knife throws. Watch for his last-ditch hyper slash.

VELVET ROOM MINI BOSS / 200 HP

Brick

The suited doorkeeper. Watch his dash punch and grabs.

DIRTY COP / BATON + TASER

Carmen

Aggressive close pressure, faster taser probes and contact shocks. Watch her wake-up sweep.

BIKER / LONG-RANGE CHAIN

Frankie

Close the gap after his chain misses.

PLAYABLE / TAEKWONDO + SWORD

Reina

Fast kicks. Positional throws. A reason to keep going.

REGULAR / FISTS + KNIFE

Marcus

Watch his pockets when his health gets low.

HEAVY / CLINCH + SLAM

Bruno

Big punches. Bigger grabs. Punish his misses.

STAGE BOSS / TWO WEAPONS

Jackal

Close-range knife pressure, mid-range bat swings. Punish heavy recovery and roll away from ground bashes. Can whistle for backup once.

NEW OPPONENTS

Skill. Speed. Wild power.

MARTIAL ARTIST / 90 HP

Saito

Shirtless kick specialist. Use counters or grabs to break his defense.

MARTIAL ARTIST / 72 HP

Akari

Violet gi, faster footwork and lighter strikes. Expect small groups.

ESCAPED CON / 95 HP

Flint

Knife, pipe, 2×4 or wooden bat. Sometimes appears unarmed, fighting with fists and a front kick. Strong swings; punish his recovery.

SKYLAR NOVA / HIGH-FLYING WRESTLER

Fast hands. Big air.

115 HP · fastest walk · higher jump. Direction is relative to the way Skylar faces.

Strikes and flight

Attack: five-hit combo, 29 total damage. The opening hit must connect to continue. Double-tap forward + Attack: handstand, flips and splits. Hold Attack 2s to automatically enter Hype Mode: ten seconds of strength, speed and armor, plus 20% health recovery. Unlimited activations in this test build. Jump + Attack: neutral kick (11 damage) or moving dropkick (14 damage). Down + Attack in the air: cannonball drop (13 damage).

Wrestling grabs

Front grab + Attack: two knees and a head-to-knee strike, 28 total damage. Forward: tornado DDT. Back: belly-to-belly suplex and flip follow-up, 29 total damage. Rear grab + forward: face smash. Rear grab + back: Frankensteiner. Grab + Special: Exploding Nova (18 HP): skyward signal, shoulder launch, corkscrew and body splash. Its pressure rings deal zero damage and keep nearby enemies from advancing until Nova recovers. Bruno needs ≤60% HP, Brick ≤25%; Jackal and other bosses are excluded.

Specials and counters

Special: splits clearout, 18 damage (12 HP). Forward + Special: rushing ten-hit combination, 40 total damage, ending in a double dropkick and backflip (18 HP). Counters: punch → shoulder vault/head yank; kick → leaping face kick; knife → shoulder arm break and flip; long weapon → seize, bash and break. Shared rules apply. Airborne specials remain disabled.

FOREST / THE HUNTER & GUNNER

Work as a pack.

120 HP · methodical power and range. Gunner follows automatically, never blocks movement and has no health bar. R1 counters use latched direction and timed interceptions.

Knife, then crossbow

The opening knife slash must connect before the combo can continue. Six separate Attack presses: three knife slashes, then three crossbow bolts with increasing knockback (36 total damage). Forward, forward + Attack: advancing slashes into Gunner’s tackle. Hold Attack 2 seconds, then release to command Gunner Maul. Jump + Attack: downward swipe; moving jump: heel drop; down + Attack in air: knife stab.

Restrain and finish

Grab + Attack: three individual knees, then a spinning knife finisher. Choose a directional throw between knees. Front away: arch throw + Gunner; front forward: spinebuster + kneedrop. Rear forward: restraint + Gunner; rear away: back-to-back flip, Gunner and two knife strikes. Jump changes grab positions.

Control the crowd

Special: two front knife swipes and three rear bites (16 HP). Forward + Special: five straight piercing bolts (20 HP). Grab + Special: five knife hits into a hard takedown (20 HP). L1 blocks, ○ dodges; Counters: punch → knife stab and knockdown kick; kick → sweep, crossbow and Gunner; knife → dodging slash; long weapon → slip behind with cross slash. Forest refuses foreign weapons. Shared rules apply. Gunner can be targeted and temporarily stunned. His existing mode-dependent protection, low-HP targeting and item retrieval share their established cooldowns; commanded attacks remain separate. A completed Maul charge is held while Gunner recovers.

FOREST & GUNNER · MOVE INSPECTOR → · GUNNER · AI INSPECTOR → · FOREST · COUNTER INSPECTOR →

CASINO / HIGH STAKES

The floor. The suite. The terrace.

Start from Scene Select → Level 4 · Casino. Fight across the gaming floor, clear the enemies and walk up to the marked penthouse elevator. Cross the suite and take the rear patio door to the pool terrace. At the pool, defeat the remaining guards to face Ophelia and Jameson together. Knock either boss into the violet-lit pool for 10 seconds of breathing room; the surviving partner becomes enraged and loses boss defenses.

Three slot machines and one table at the edges of the combat area can be destroyed. Each slot machine has one 50/50 chance to drop a single ordinary item. The breakable table has a 30% chance. Destroyed machines and the table disappear. Background games and patrons remain scenery.

Security: 130 HP. Black-uniformed heavy guards use aggressive punch combinations, front kicks and throws. Read their windups, then punish recovery. Only one active Security guard appears at a time. Casino lights are steady; reduced-motion preferences also disable small table animations. No casino strobes or pool lightning flashes.

NIKO / THE SPECIAL AGENT

Defend. Disable. Reposition.

110 HP. Four separate Attack presses: three palms and a front kick (16 base damage). Front grab: punch, elbow, leaping knee (14 base). Hold Attack 3 seconds and release for Thunder Palms. Forward, forward + Attack: Blur Dash. Dodge: short sidestep, universal 2-second cooldown.

Grab + forward/back + Attack chooses a leg-catch rolling takedown, brief leg hold and quick snap / away arm-control takedown with simultaneous arm twist and head stomp; rear grab chooses knee disruption/reverse DDT. Down + Attack near an eligible grounded enemy initiates a leg submission, once per enemy every7 seconds. Grab + Special attempts arm and leg injuries. Neutral Special requires one eligible opponent on each side. Forward + Special is a punishable dash counter.

Arm Injury lasts up to12 seconds and halves punches, throws and weapon damage; Leg Injury lasts up to10 seconds and halves kicks/movement; Concussion lasts up to8 seconds with occasional short stuns. Strong enemies and bosses resist chances and durations. No stacking or refresh damage farming. A successful injury produces a crack and pain cry. Blocking takes half the usual chip damage; the first offensive action within1.2 seconds after a successful block gains12% damage. Counters: punch → arm takedown and shoulder break; kick → caught-leg knee elbow and throw; weapon → steal. After a catch, Special chooses Battle Cry: rapid punches/kicks and a roundhouse, retaining 8% HP cost. Shared defense totals apply.

ORION / THE UNFINISHED EXPERIMENT

Slow steps. Sudden voltage.

130 HP. Once an office worker, Orion escaped the syndicate’s unfinished conversion into a controllable cyborg. His weathered coat conceals the machinery; his sarcasm conceals less.

Attack: three kicks and a spinning piston punch (30 damage). Double-tap forward + Attack: Electric Meteor, a short booster arc with an electrical landing. Hold Attack 3 seconds, then release: System Repair restores 22 HP and full defense, once per life. Charging plants his feet and can be interrupted; changing rooms does not restore it.

Grab + Attack: lift, punches and ground smash. Front hold + forward/away + Attack: Shock Blast / Robo Slam. Rear hold + forward/away + Attack: Charged Piston Punch / Inverted Booster Slam. Strong-target grab restrictions remain in force. Grab + Special: Electric Ascension Slam (25 HP).

Neutral Special: Ground Current travels both ways (16 HP). Forward + Special: Golden Visor Laser reaches the visible edge and stops at sufficiently tall solid objects (18 HP). Both have vulnerable startup and recovery. Electrical stun is short, resisted and followed by immunity; repeated shocks weaken. Air + Attack: neutral kick or moving knee; down + Attack in air: hammer-fist. Dodge: Retreating Boost, 25 defense and a two-second cooldown. Counters: punch → lift, electrocute and throw; kick → Rugbeat repeated slams; knife → charged punch; long weapon → steal and electrify. Shared counter rules apply.

Keyboard J attack, K jump, L special, G grab/release, Q dodge, B block. DualSense □ attack, × jump, △ special, L2 grab, ○ dodge, L1 block; R2 or double-tap to run. ORION · FRAME AND COMBAT INSPECTOR →

URBAN FRACTURE / DOWNTOWN / SPRITE UPDATEIllustrated pixel sprites · Seven downtown encounters · P to pause

ENVIRONMENT · SEED LAB → · OUTDOOR TEMPLATE · TEST → · SMART AI · INSPECTOR → · GRAPPLING · ANIMATION INSPECTOR → · CHARGE / TORNADO · INSPECTOR → · WEAPON COUNTERS · INSPECTOR → · EXPLODING NOVA · INSPECTOR →

Pick up. Fight. Throw.

E / R3 picks up a nearby dropped weapon. Attack uses it; E / R3 again throws it away. Each attack sequence that damages an enemy consumes one of five uses. Misses do not count; multi-hit attacks consume only one use. Throws break on impact or landing.

Reina excels with knives; Broxton with long weapons. Nova is least proficient, Niko is average, and Orion deals the most weapon damage with electrical strikes. Forest keeps his own knife and does not pick up enemy weapons. Short weapons include knives/scalpels; long weapons include pipes, bats, planks and crowbars.

A former syndicate enforcer. Strong punches, deliberate footwork, devastating grabs.

ROBBER / 65 HP

Jesse

Six aimed shots. Knives up close. Punish the reload.

BANK SECURITY / 175 HP

Otis

Baton, belly ram and body splash. Attack when he is winded.

VAULT BOSS / 315 HP

Leroy

Evasive gunfire, brass knuckles, grenades below half health, and limited backup waves.

KNIFE THUG / STAB + STEP SLASH

Kevin

Stab, step-in slash and fast knife throws. Watch for his last-ditch hyper slash.

VELVET ROOM MINI BOSS / 200 HP

Brick

The suited doorkeeper. Watch his dash punch and grabs.

DIRTY COP / BATON + TASER

Carmen

Aggressive close pressure, faster taser probes and contact shocks. Watch her wake-up sweep.

BIKER / LONG-RANGE CHAIN

Frankie

Close the gap after his chain misses.

PLAYABLE / TAEKWONDO + SWORD

Reina

Fast kicks. Positional throws. A reason to keep going.

REGULAR / FISTS + KNIFE

Marcus

Watch his pockets when his health gets low.

HEAVY / CLINCH + SLAM

Bruno

Big punches. Bigger grabs. Punish his misses.

STAGE BOSS / TWO WEAPONS

Jackal

Close-range knife pressure, mid-range bat swings. Punish heavy recovery and roll away from ground bashes. Can whistle for backup once.

NEW OPPONENTS

Skill. Speed. Wild power.

MARTIAL ARTIST / 90 HP

Saito

Shirtless kick specialist. Use counters or grabs to break his defense.

MARTIAL ARTIST / 72 HP

Akari

Violet gi, faster footwork and lighter strikes. Expect small groups.

ESCAPED CON / 95 HP

Flint

Knife, pipe, 2×4 or wooden bat. Sometimes appears unarmed, fighting with fists and a front kick. Strong swings; punish his recovery.

SKYLAR NOVA / HIGH-FLYING WRESTLER

Fast hands. Big air.

115 HP · fastest walk · higher jump. Direction is relative to the way Skylar faces.

Strikes and flight

Attack: five-hit combo, 29 total damage. The opening hit must connect to continue. Double-tap forward + Attack: handstand, flips and splits. Hold Attack 2s to automatically enter Hype Mode: ten seconds of strength, speed and armor, plus 20% health recovery. Unlimited activations in this test build. Jump + Attack: neutral kick (11 damage) or moving dropkick (14 damage). Down + Attack in the air: cannonball drop (13 damage).

Wrestling grabs

Front grab + Attack: two knees and a head-to-knee strike, 28 total damage. Forward: tornado DDT. Back: belly-to-belly suplex and flip follow-up, 29 total damage. Rear grab + forward: face smash. Rear grab + back: Frankensteiner. Grab + Special: Exploding Nova (18 HP): skyward signal, shoulder launch, corkscrew and body splash. Its pressure rings deal zero damage and keep nearby enemies from advancing until Nova recovers. Bruno needs ≤60% HP, Brick ≤25%; Jackal and other bosses are excluded.

Specials and counters

Special: splits clearout, 18 damage (12 HP). Forward + Special: rushing ten-hit combination, 40 total damage, ending in a double dropkick and backflip (18 HP). Counters: punch → shoulder vault/head yank; kick → leaping face kick; knife → shoulder arm break and flip; long weapon → seize, bash and break. Shared rules apply. Airborne specials remain disabled.

FOREST / THE HUNTER & GUNNER

Work as a pack.

120 HP · methodical power and range. Gunner follows automatically, never blocks movement and has no health bar. R1 counters use latched direction and timed interceptions.

Knife, then crossbow

The opening knife slash must connect before the combo can continue. Six separate Attack presses: three knife slashes, then three crossbow bolts with increasing knockback (36 total damage). Forward, forward + Attack: advancing slashes into Gunner’s tackle. Hold Attack 2 seconds, then release to command Gunner Maul. Jump + Attack: downward swipe; moving jump: heel drop; down + Attack in air: knife stab.

Restrain and finish

Grab + Attack: three individual knees, then a spinning knife finisher. Choose a directional throw between knees. Front away: arch throw + Gunner; front forward: spinebuster + kneedrop. Rear forward: restraint + Gunner; rear away: back-to-back flip, Gunner and two knife strikes. Jump changes grab positions.

Control the crowd

Special: two front knife swipes and three rear bites (16 HP). Forward + Special: five straight piercing bolts (20 HP). Grab + Special: five knife hits into a hard takedown (20 HP). L1 blocks, ○ dodges; Counters: punch → knife stab and knockdown kick; kick → sweep, crossbow and Gunner; knife → dodging slash; long weapon → slip behind with cross slash. Forest refuses foreign weapons. Shared rules apply. Gunner can be targeted and temporarily stunned. His existing mode-dependent protection, low-HP targeting and item retrieval share their established cooldowns; commanded attacks remain separate. A completed Maul charge is held while Gunner recovers.

FOREST & GUNNER · MOVE INSPECTOR → · GUNNER · AI INSPECTOR → · FOREST · COUNTER INSPECTOR →

CASINO / HIGH STAKES

The floor. The suite. The terrace.

Start from Scene Select → Level 4 · Casino. Fight across the gaming floor, clear the enemies and walk up to the marked penthouse elevator. Cross the suite and take the rear patio door to the pool terrace. At the pool, defeat the remaining guards to face Ophelia and Jameson together. Knock either boss into the violet-lit pool for 10 seconds of breathing room; the surviving partner becomes enraged and loses boss defenses.

Three slot machines and one table at the edges of the combat area can be destroyed. Each slot machine has one 50/50 chance to drop a single ordinary item. The breakable table has a 30% chance. Destroyed machines and the table disappear. Background games and patrons remain scenery.

Security: 130 HP. Black-uniformed heavy guards use aggressive punch combinations, front kicks and throws. Read their windups, then punish recovery. Only one active Security guard appears at a time. Casino lights are steady; reduced-motion preferences also disable small table animations. No casino strobes or pool lightning flashes.

NIKO / THE SPECIAL AGENT

Defend. Disable. Reposition.

110 HP. Four separate Attack presses: three palms and a front kick (16 base damage). Front grab: punch, elbow, leaping knee (14 base). Hold Attack 3 seconds and release for Thunder Palms. Forward, forward + Attack: Blur Dash. Dodge: short sidestep, universal 2-second cooldown.

Grab + forward/back + Attack chooses a leg-catch rolling takedown, brief leg hold and quick snap / away arm-control takedown with simultaneous arm twist and head stomp; rear grab chooses knee disruption/reverse DDT. Down + Attack near an eligible grounded enemy initiates a leg submission, once per enemy every7 seconds. Grab + Special attempts arm and leg injuries. Neutral Special requires one eligible opponent on each side. Forward + Special is a punishable dash counter.

Arm Injury lasts up to12 seconds and halves punches, throws and weapon damage; Leg Injury lasts up to10 seconds and halves kicks/movement; Concussion lasts up to8 seconds with occasional short stuns. Strong enemies and bosses resist chances and durations. No stacking or refresh damage farming. A successful injury produces a crack and pain cry. Blocking takes half the usual chip damage; the first offensive action within1.2 seconds after a successful block gains12% damage. Counters: punch → arm takedown and shoulder break; kick → caught-leg knee elbow and throw; weapon → steal. After a catch, Special chooses Battle Cry: rapid punches/kicks and a roundhouse, retaining 8% HP cost. Shared defense totals apply.

ORION / THE UNFINISHED EXPERIMENT

Slow steps. Sudden voltage.

130 HP. Once an office worker, Orion escaped the syndicate’s unfinished conversion into a controllable cyborg. His weathered coat conceals the machinery; his sarcasm conceals less.

Attack: three kicks and a spinning piston punch (30 damage). Double-tap forward + Attack: Electric Meteor, a short booster arc with an electrical landing. Hold Attack 3 seconds, then release: System Repair restores 22 HP and full defense, once per life. Charging plants his feet and can be interrupted; changing rooms does not restore it.

Grab + Attack: lift, punches and ground smash. Front hold + forward/away + Attack: Shock Blast / Robo Slam. Rear hold + forward/away + Attack: Charged Piston Punch / Inverted Booster Slam. Strong-target grab restrictions remain in force. Grab + Special: Electric Ascension Slam (25 HP).

Neutral Special: Ground Current travels both ways (16 HP). Forward + Special: Golden Visor Laser reaches the visible edge and stops at sufficiently tall solid objects (18 HP). Both have vulnerable startup and recovery. Electrical stun is short, resisted and followed by immunity; repeated shocks weaken. Air + Attack: neutral kick or moving knee; down + Attack in air: hammer-fist. Dodge: Retreating Boost, 25 defense and a two-second cooldown. Counters: punch → lift, electrocute and throw; kick → Rugbeat repeated slams; knife → charged punch; long weapon → steal and electrify. Shared counter rules apply.

Keyboard J attack, K jump, L special, G grab/release, Q dodge, B block. DualSense □ attack, × jump, △ special, L2 grab, ○ dodge, L1 block; R2 or double-tap to run. ORION · FRAME AND COMBAT INSPECTOR →

ENVIRONMENT · SEED LAB → · OUTDOOR TEMPLATE · TEST → · SMART AI · INSPECTOR → · GRAPPLING · ANIMATION INSPECTOR → · CHARGE / TORNADO · INSPECTOR → · WEAPON COUNTERS · INSPECTOR → · EXPLODING NOVA · INSPECTOR →

Pick up. Fight. Throw.

E / R3 picks up a nearby dropped weapon. Attack uses it; E / R3 again throws it away. Each attack sequence that damages an enemy consumes one of five uses. Misses do not count; multi-hit attacks consume only one use. Throws break on impact or landing.

Reina excels with knives; Broxton with long weapons. Nova is least proficient, Niko is average, and Orion deals the most weapon damage with electrical strikes. Forest keeps his own knife and does not pick up enemy weapons. Short weapons include knives/scalpels; long weapons include pipes, bats, planks and crowbars.
